in_sanskrit.name: जीविका
in_sanskrit.meaning: जीव (Life) + का (Desire or Will) = जीविका (Desire of Life or Will to Live)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has the desire or will to live, or one who nourishes and sustains life.

in_hindi.name: जीविका
in_hindi.meaning: जीव (जीवन) + का (काम) = जीविका (जीवन का अमेरा या जीवन की अधीनता)
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who has the desire or the mastery over life, or one who nourishes and sustains life.

in_tamil.name: ஜிவிகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who has the desire for life or the one who nourishes and sustains life.

in_telugu.name: జీవికా
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who has the desire or the goddess of life, or one who nourishes and sustains life.

in_marathi.name: Jivika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Life giving, Vitality
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jivika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jivika is a Sanskrit word that means 'life giving' or 'vitality'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit root 'jiv', which means 'to live'. In Hindu mythology, Jivika is a name given to the goddess of life and vitality, who is believed to nurture and sustain all living beings.
